messages:
Nina V: starting deploy v2.4.7 -> prod. planned canary 1% for 10m. feature flag ff:route-split enabled for canary. change window until 04:15 UTC.
Deploy-Bot: deploy initiated id=deploy-1739000000 status=CANARY. gating rules active.
Sam C: note: this build includes a tiny KV-cache tweak for reranker. watch cache-miss logs and tail latency.
ops-bot: initial canary (5m): 5xx=0.02% baseline 0.03%, latency +3% - no gate.
Rita K: seeing spillover for premium->free routing in eu-west. looks like cohort boundary logic slipped.
Nina V: quick mitigation: pin premium cohort to v2.4.6 routing while canary proceeds for everyone else. apply toggle for cohort=premium state=off.
Deploy-Bot: flag update applied: ff:route-split for cohort=premium set to off. rollout continues for remaining cohorts.
ops-bot: canary (12m): 5xx=0.04% latency +1% - stable. premium cohort metrics normal after pin.
QA Bot: premium smoke on pinned version passed. no user-facing regressions.
Sam C: will collect logs and submit follow-up PR to tighten cohort checks.
Nina V: decision: continue canary to 5% for 15m. keep premium pinned. auto-rollback enabled if 5xx >0.5% for 5m.
Deploy-Bot: rollback policy set. To cancel run `deploy abort-rollback deploy-1739000000`.
release_notes: v2.4.7 canary: rolling to 1% then 5%. Premium cohort pinned to v2.4.6 due to cohort-routing spillover; monitoring and follow-up PR planned.
